messages:

Subject: Request: full sweep of prompt outputs + logs (Finno prod)

Hi Sean,

Following our compliance review, Finno Health needs a complete purge of any prompt inputs, model outputs, and associated inference logs generated for our account between 2024-06-01 and 2026-10-31. We discussed this on the call last week; please confirm Redwood's deletion workflow and provide the artefacts you will deliver as proof (manifests, checksums, retention pointers). Additionally, our auditor (sec-audit@greybox.io) may request metadata-only evidence; we do not need model weights or customer data dumps.

Can you confirm timeline and whether any manual steps from Finno are required?

Thanks,
Alice Kim
Security Operations
Finno Health

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: full sweep of prompt outputs + logs (Finno prod)

Alice —

Thanks for the clear scope. High level plan we can execute this week:

1) Identification: run account-scoped query for prompt input IDs, output blobs, and inference trace entries across the time window.
2) Isolation: snapshot matching keys and move to a purge queue (no live reads).
3) Sanitization: remove prompt outputs from object storage, zeroize indexing records, and scrub KV cache entries.
4) Log expiration: remove or redact inference logs (subject to audit evidence rules) and rotate any short-lived tracing IDs.
5) Evidence package: deliver a CSV manifest with object paths, deletion timestamps, and MD5 checksums, plus a PDF summary.

Timeline: identification and isolation complete within 48 hours of your sign-off; final evidence delivered within 5 business days. Manual steps: none required on your side unless you want a coordinated downtime window (not necessary).

I will loop in Karthik for the final sweep and the signed manifest.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Folks — quick ops update before the sweep:

- Identification job (account_id=finno-123) located ~12,372 output blobs and 1,780 trace entries in the target window.
- We will run deletion in two phases to preserve ability to recreate evidence for auditors if needed:
  * Phase A (logical purge): remove public object links, mark records deleted, snapshot manifests. Repeatable and fast.
  * Phase B (physical scrub): overwrite objects on storage and expunge indexing records; will take longer due to storage provider wipe windows.
- Expected Phase A completion: 2026-11-16T22:00:00-08:00. Phase B finalization and evidence delivery: 2026-11-17T16:00:00-08:00.

Artifacts we will attach in the final email: sweep_manifest_20261117.csv, md5_checksums.txt, and a PDF deletion report. We will also include a compact audit-only JSON (metadata-only) for Greybox if they request.

No approvals required from Finno to proceed — we just need to confirm they are comfortable with the Phase B timing (overnight window).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Inference Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

Alice / Sec team —

Phase A and Phase B have completed. Attached are the artefacts for your records:

- sweep_manifest_20261117.csv — list of object paths (redacted for PII), deletion timestamps, and operation IDs.
- md5_checksums.txt — pre- and post-deletion checksums where applicable.
- redwood_deletion_report-20261117.pdf — summary of steps, accounts touched, and Ops run IDs.

Highlights / assurances:
- KV cache entries referenced by Finno queries were scrubbed and TTL reset where applicable; no live pointers remain.
- Inference traces older than the window were redacted; trace IDs that remain are anonymized for telemetry.
- No model weights or non-customer artifacts were touched.

Next steps for Finno: your auditor can validate the artifacts and request metadata-only extracts. If Greybox needs the compact audit JSON, please let us know and we will deliver it over a secure transfer (we will not include any raw prompt texts).

Thanks — sending this as confirmation required by your compliance team.

Best,
